title: Factors Impacting Developer Efficiency: Results from an Adaptive Longitudinal Study

evidence.sentence: A generative AI usage barrier emerged in the qualitative data nine waves into the study and was subsequently incorporated into the survey instrument, becoming the most frequently coded theme in the interviews.
Data Analysis 1) Quantitative data: Survey data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, including percentage frequencies of the reported factors in each data collection wave.

data_generation_methods.evidence: This study adopted a mixed-methods longitudinal case study design, combining recurring surveys and semi-structured interviews to investigate how factors affecting developer efficiency vary over time.
